invariants.description: charge conservation across modules: the charge on the membrane changes by exactly the cation charge that crossed it, Cm dV = F Vol d(Na_i + K_i + 2 Ca_total + H_total - lactate + ATP): protons from ATP hydrolysis and those leaving with lactate carry no membrane charge (relative 1e-6)
invariants.expr: abs(mod__membrane__Cm[0]*1e-12*(mod__membrane__V[-1] - mod__membrane__V[0])*1e-3 - 96485*mod__membrane__Vol[0]*((mod__Na_K__Nai[-1] - mod__Na_K__Nai[0]) + (mod__Na_K__Ki[-1] - mod__Na_K__Ki[0]) + 2*((mod__Ca__Cai + mod__Ca__CaB_Cai)[-1] - (mod__Ca__Cai + mod__Ca__CaB_Cai)[0]) + (mod__H__H_total_rel[-1] - mod__H__H_total_rel[0]) - (mod__cytosol__C_lac[-1] - mod__cytosol__C_lac[0]) + (mod__cytosol__C_ATP[-1] - mod__cytosol__C_ATP[0]))) <= 1e-6*96485*mod__membrane__Vol[0]*(abs((mod__Na_K__Nai[-1] - mod__Na_K__Nai[0])) + abs((mod__Na_K__Ki[-1] - mod__Na_K__Ki[0])) + abs((mod__H__H_total_rel[-1] - mod__H__H_total_rel[0]))) + 1e-21

invariants.description: adenine and phosphoryl groups are conserved through every ATP user and the PTS: ATP + ADP and ATP + Pi + G6P constant (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.ptp(mod__cytosol__C_ATP + mod__cytosol__C_ADP) <= 1e-9*np.max(mod__cytosol__C_ATP + mod__cytosol__C_ADP) and np.ptp(mod__cytosol__C_ATP + mod__cytosol__C_Pi + mod__cytosol__C_G6P) <= 1e-9*np.max(mod__cytosol__C_ATP + mod__cytosol__C_Pi + mod__cytosol__C_G6P)

invariants.description: the ATP budget closes: the cytosol's external ATP use equals what the H+-ATPase (if present), protein synthesis and biosynthesis take (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(mod__cytosol__J_ATP_turnover - mod__cytosol__J_ATP_maint, mod__protein__J_ATP_total + mod__bio__J_ATP_bio, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: second law for the leaks: each runs down its electrochemical gradient, i (V - E) >= 0
concentrations stay non-negative: ATP, ADP, Pi, glucose, G6P, lactate and glycogen >= -1e-9 mM
invariants.expr: np.all(mod__cytosol__C_glc >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod__cytosol__C_lac >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod__cytosol__C_ATP >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod__cytosol__C_ADP >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod__cytosol__C_Pi >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod__cytosol__C_G6P >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod__cytosol__C_glyc >= -1e-9)

invariants.description: second law for the reactions: dissipation P_diss >= 0
regulation stays within 0-1 and, with its switches off (the default), leaves growth's target exactly as asked: R_reg = 1
invariants.expr: np.all((mod__reg__f_ATP_reg >= 0) & (mod__reg__f_ATP_reg <= 1)) and np.all((mod__reg__f_G6P_reg >= 0) & (mod__reg__f_G6P_reg <= 1)) and np.all((mod__reg__f_glc_reg >= 0) & (mod__reg__f_glc_reg <= 1)) and np.all((mod__reg__f_H_reg >= 0) & (mod__reg__f_H_reg <= 1)) and (param["bio/reg_on_ATP"] or param["bio/reg_on_G6P"] or param["bio/reg_on_glc"] or param["bio/reg_on_H"] or np.all(mod__bio__R_reg == 1.0))

invariants.description: protein synthesis never spends more than its capacity: J_build_total <= J_cap (relative 1e-9)

amino acids are conserved through proteolysis and recycling: N_aa(t) - N_aa(0) = int (released - reused - catabolised) dt (relative 1e-4: trapezoid integration of the logged fluxes), and N_aa stays non-negative
invariants.expr: abs((mod__protein__N_aa[-1] - mod__protein__N_aa[0]) - np.trapz(mod__protein__Q_aa_rel_total - mod__protein__Q_aa_use_total - mod__protein__r_aa_cat, t)) <= 1e-4*np.trapz(np.abs(mod__protein__Q_aa_rel_total) + np.abs(mod__protein__Q_aa_use_total) + np.abs(mod__protein__r_aa_cat), t) + 1e-6 and np.all(mod__protein__N_aa >= -1e-6)

bc_sweep.rationale: temperatures from 0 to 40 C (the default factors of 0.5 and 2 would put the cell at 147 K and 586 K, where Q10 = 2 changes every rate by 2^15 to 2^29 and nothing physical remains to check); R and F are physical constants, not swept; protein expression targets x0.25-4, growth 0-20x the resting turnover, repair and storage 0-1: the ranges AdaptOrDeity lets a player choose
